subject: pharmacology
title: Beta-lactams: penicillins, cephalosporins and carbapenems

steps.tx: **Penicillins** sort spectrum: benzylpenicillin (strep, meningococcus, syphilis; short half life), **aminopenicillins** (amoxicillin, ampicillin; **EBV rash** warns, enterococcus, Listeria with gentamicin), antistaphylococcal (cloxacillin, nafcillin; MSSA), antipseudomonal (**piperacillin tazobactam** febrile neutropenia and nosocomial). **Amoxicillin rash in mononucleosis** (not allergy, rechallenge safe) confuses; nephritis with cytopenias hypersensitises rarely. Procaine and benzathine depot (syphilis, rheumatic prophylaxis) stretch.
steps.say: EBV amoxicillin rash is not allergy: rechallenge later. Febrile neutropenia gets pip-tazo; Listeria ampicillin plus gentamicin.

steps.tx: **Cephalosporins** generation hop: first (**cefazolin** surgical prophylaxis, MSSA), second (**cefuroxime** respiratory, cefoxitin anaerobes), third (**ceftriaxone** meningitis and gonorrhoea with **biliary sludge**, **ceftazidime** pseudomonas, cefixime gonorrhoea oral, cefotaxime neonates), fourth (**cefepime** febrile neutropenia and pseudomonas), fifth (**ceftaroline** MRSA pneumonia). Ceftriaxone displaces bilirubin (neonates caution) with calcium stones; oral cefuroxime axetil steps down. Generation trades Gram positive for negative.
steps.say: Surgical cefazolin, meningitic ceftriaxone, pseudomonal ceftazidime or cefepime, MRSA ceftaroline. Neonatal ceftriaxone displaces bilirubin.

steps.tx: **Carbapenems** (**meropenem, imipenem with cilastatin** blocking renal dehydropeptidase, doripenem; broadest including ESBL, **seizures** imipenem most, valproate levels crashed) reserve ESBL and resistant nosocomial; **ertapenem** (once daily, no pseudomonas or Acinetobacter) suits community ESBL UTI. **Aztreonam** (monobactam, Gram negative only, **penicillin allergy safe** except ceftazidime shared side chain rare) bridges allergic sepsis. De-escalation cultures narrow; stewardship locks carbapenems.
steps.say: ESBL nosocomial gets meropenem; community UTI ertapenem (no pseudomonas). Penicillin allergic Gram negative sepsis: aztreonam.

steps.tx: **Beta-lactamase inhibitors** (clavulanate with amoxicillin: **hepatotoxic**, co-amoxiclav diarrhoea; sulbactam with ampicillin; tazobactam with piperacillin; **avibactam** with ceftazidime rescuing KPC) never work alone. **Penicillin allergy** (anaphylaxis IgE with skin testing, **cephalosporin cross reactivity low around 2 percent** except shared chains, carbapenem tolerated mostly, **desensitisation** protocols where no alternative) is de-labelled when viral rash or GI upset mislabelled. Allergy bands kill when wrong.
steps.say: Clavulanate hepatitises; avibactam rescues KPC. True anaphylaxis skin tests; EBV rash de-labels.
